description:
★ ORDER OF QUESTIONS (STRICT — applies whether you ask one at a time OR bundle several into a single message): when → mode → strategy (serial/parallel, IMMEDIATE runs) → release → sprint → environment → schedule fields → agent. Ask in THIS order, always — never schema-declaration order, never refusal-arrival order, never a 'natural UI' order (release first is WRONG). Skip sprint when release=''. Suites do NOT ask version / browser / device — each TC in the suite carries its own. ★

Execute an existing test SUITE — all its member test cases, in order — in the connected product. ASK the user for EVERY field the UI's Execute-suite dialog asks — never assume — in this DEPENDENCY ORDER: (0) if a previous run in this session left a config for the project, the tool refuses first asking `reuseConfig` (true=merge remembered mode/release/sprint/agent (the ENVIRONMENT is always asked), false=start fresh); (1) `when` immediate/schedule, (2) `mode` local/remote/cloud, (3) `strategy` SERIAL/PARALLEL — the UI's PARALLEL/SERIAL radio, shown for LOCAL, REMOTE and CLOUD alike (ask it for an immediate run), (4) `releaseId` (from list_releases; pass '' to skip), (5) `sprintId` (from list_sprints; skipped entirely when releaseId=''), (6) `environment` (from tc_list_environments), (7) for a schedule the start time + recurrence (ASK — Once / Every 5 Minutes / Hourly / Daily / Weekly / Monthly, never default) + end date + timezone, (8) THEN offer the eligible agent/runner. IF YOU BATCH SEVERAL REFUSED FIELDS INTO ONE AskUserQuestion, ORDER the questions EXACTLY as above (when → mode → strategy → release → sprint → environment → schedule fields → agent) — never in schema order or refusal order. UNLIKE `tc_run`, a suite does NOT ask for `versionId` or `browser` — each TC in the suite carries its own pinned version + execution platform (that's what the suite editor picks per row). ★ RECOMMEND PARALLEL when the suite has more than one test case that can run independently (they dispatch concurrently — much faster); recommend SERIAL when the cases must run in order or share state (create → verify → delete, one shared login, a single local browser profile). The UI preselects SERIAL — say WHY you suggest parallel.
`mode` decides WHERE it runs:
  • 'local' — THIS machine's desktop agent. Runs SERIAL or PARALLEL exactly as asked (parallel dispatches each TC as its own child execution). Call `local_agents` (0 or 1 row). For when:'immediate' the tool probes :4040 and refuses if the desktop agent is down. Omit `agentId` to auto-pick this machine's agent; for when:'schedule' `agentId` is REQUIRED.
  • 'remote' — ANOTHER registered machine's desktop agent, SERIAL or PARALLEL as asked. Call `remote_agents`; `agentId` is REQUIRED (no auto-pick). when:'immediate' → ONLINE only; when:'schedule' → offline OK.
  • 'cloud' — online cloud runner VM(s) (ONLINE-only whether now or scheduled). Pass `cloudRunnerId` from cloud_runners; for a schedule omit it to auto-pick a live VM at fire time.
For cloud, if no runner is online it reports that there are no active cloud runners (nothing is run).
NOTE: manual suites go through the same dispatch — the backend stores them as an execution (no agent picks them up until steps are marked from the UI).

agentId.description: STEP 8 — for local: a credential_id from `local_agents` (this machine only; omit to auto-pick). For remote: REQUIRED — a credential_id from `remote_agents`. when:'immediate' → picked agent must be ONLINE; when:'schedule' → offline OK, agentId REQUIRED for both local and remote.

browser.description: Optional at the SUITE level — each TC in the suite has its own execution platform (that's the suite-editor pick per row). Provide only to OVERRIDE for every WEB TC. Values: 'chromium' (default), 'chrome'/'msedge', 'firefox', 'webkit'. ON THE CLOUD (mode 'cloud') the ONLY choices are Chrome Headless, Firefox Headless and Edge Headless (pass 'chrome', 'firefox' or 'edge' — each means its headless one); never offer safari/webkit/chromium there. A suite or plan run in the cloud asks for it when a web test case has no saved cloud browser. For a SCHEDULE on SimplifyQA, 'chrome' (and 'chromium') = Chrome, 'msedge'/'edge' = Edge, 'firefox', 'webkit'/'safari' = Safari — chrome is fine; on Walnut a schedule accepts only chromium/msedge/firefox/webkit. A schedule whose mode is CLOUD is headless too: offer only Chrome Headless / Firefox Headless / Edge Headless there.

cloudRunnerId.description: STEP 8 (cloud) — a specific ONLINE runner id (from cloud_runners). For when:'schedule' omit to auto-pick a live VM at fire time.

dayOfMonth.description: Monthly 'ON DAY': 1–30; default = the start's day.

daysOfWeek.description: Weekly: the weekdays to run on (MONDAY … SUNDAY or MON … SUN); default = the start's weekday. Monthly with `occurrence`: the one weekday.

endDate.description: SCHEDULE STEP — ISO end date; REQUIRED when scheduleType is anything but 'once'. ASK the user.

environment.description: STEP 6 — environment key (from tc_list_environments). ASK the user on EVERY suite run; the UI marks this required for a suite. Never inherited from a previous run — reuseConfig does not fill it.

headless.description: Headless. Defaults: cloud=true, local=false. (Immediate runs only.)

interval.description: REPEAT EVERY N for hourly / daily / weekly / monthly — N hours / days / weeks / months (e.g. hourly + 2 = every 2 hours). Default 1. With 'every_5_minutes' it is the N in 'every N minutes'. Not for 'once'.

maxConcurrent.description: Cloud parallel only — maps to globalConfiguration.MAXIMUM_CONTAINER_COUNT on the wire.

mode.description: STEP 2 — where to run. REQUIRED, ASK the user if unstated. 'stack' runs the suite's saved Stack setup (the UI's Execution Type → Stack): set it up first with suite_manage action:'stack_setup'; immediate runs only, serial per stack.

occurrence.description: Monthly 'ON THE': the first / second / third / last weekday of the month — give the weekday in daysOfWeek.

releaseId.description: STEP 4 — release from list_releases. ASK the user; pass '' to skip (no release / no sprint asked).

reuseConfig.description: Set only when the tool refused asking about REUSE. true = merge the previous run's mode/release/sprint/browser/agent/runner into any unset field; the ENVIRONMENT is never merged — it is asked on every run; false = ignore prior config. Omit on a first run.

scheduleName.description: when:'schedule' — the schedule's NAME as the Scheduler shows it (3–501 characters, unique in the project), e.g. 'nightly smoke'. Omit it and the schedule is named '<TC-22> schedule' (numbered when taken).

scheduleType.description: SCHEDULE STEP — REQUIRED for when:'schedule'; ASK the user explicitly, never assume. The UI's Recurrence choices: 'once', 'every_5_minutes', 'hourly', 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly'. Anything but 'once' also needs endDate. ('weekdays' = weekly Mon–Fri, MCP shortcut — don't offer it.) REPEAT EVERY N: hourly / daily / weekly / monthly take `interval` N — 'every 3 hours' = hourly + interval 3, 'every 2 days' = daily + interval 2, 'every 2 weeks' = weekly + interval 2 (default 1); weekly takes `daysOfWeek`; monthly takes `dayOfMonth` (1–30) OR `occurrence` (first/second/third/last) + one weekday in `daysOfWeek`. MINUTES: 'every N minutes' = 'every_5_minutes' + `interval` N (the product stores it as EVERY_5_MINUTES with that interval; without a number it is 5).

scheduledFor.description: STEP 6 — REQUIRED for when:'schedule'; ISO datetime of the first/only run (e.g. '2026-08-20T09:00:00Z').

sprintId.description: STEP 5 — sprint from list_sprints (scoped to release). Only asked when releaseId is non-empty; skipped when releaseId=''. Pass '' to skip.

strategy.description: STEP 3 (immediate runs) — SERIAL or PARALLEL across the suite's test cases: the same choice the UI's Execute-suite dialog shows as a PARALLEL/SERIAL radio, and it applies to LOCAL, REMOTE and CLOUD alike. ASK the user. RECOMMEND 'parallel' when the suite has several independent test cases (they run concurrently — much faster); recommend 'serial' when order or shared state matters. The wire defaults to SERIAL, which is why it must be asked rather than assumed.

suiteId.description: The suite id to run (from suite_list / suite_get).

terminateOnFailure.description: Stop dispatching remaining test cases after the first failure. Maps to globalConfiguration.TERMINATE_ON_FAIL on the wire.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for a schedule (e.g. 'Asia/Kolkata'). Default 'UTC'.

when.description: STEP 1 — when to run. REQUIRED, ASK the user if unstated.

name: suite_run
title: Run a test suite (local / remote / cloud; now or scheduled)
